up: Retrieve up to 200 metabolism records for the enzyme CYP2C19. Join the metabolism table with compound_records on substrate_record_id, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno and compound_structures on molregno to retrieve the substrate compound name (pref_name) and structure (canonical_smiles). Return exactly these columns: canonical_smiles as substrate_structure, pref_name as compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key as pathway, and organism. Filter the results where metabolism.enzyme_name = 'CYP2C19' or by joining target_dictionary on enzyme_tid and filtering target_dictionary.pref_name LIKE '%CYP2C19%'. Limit the output to 200 rows.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure, md.pref_name AS compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key AS pathway, m.organism FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'CYP2C19' LIMIT 200
